description.value:
Your magic flows not from mere true dragons, but from the three mythical Progenitor Wyrms who sang the cosmos into being: Siberys the Dragon Above, Eberron the Dragon Between, and Khyber the Dragon Below.

Spellcasting Tradition: When you gain this bloodline, choose one of the three Progenitor Wyrms:

  • Siberys (Arcane): The golden sky of magic and prophecy. Your tradition is Arcane. Your bloodline skills are Arcana and Society.
  • Eberron (Primal): The vibrant earth, cradle of all natural life. Your tradition is Primal. Your bloodline skills are Nature and Survival.
  • Khyber (Occult): The dark depths, prison of fiends and aberrant terrors. Your tradition is Occult. Your bloodline skills are Occultism and Intimidation.

Blood Magic: Cosmic power flares when you cast a bloodline spell. Either you or one ally within 30 feet gains temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank (minimum 1) for 1 round, or one target of the spell takes force damage equal to the spell's rank.

Granted Focus Spells: Initial: @UUID[Compendium.pathfinders-guide-to-eberron.eberron-spells.soc2024mm0000017]{Shape of Creation}; Advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pathfinders-guide-to-eberron.eberron-spells.col2024mm0000018]{Cradle of Life}; Greater: @UUID[Compendium.pathfinders-guide-to-eberron.eberron-spells.pga2024mm0000019]{Progenitor's Awakening}.
